correctness.rationale: For all r>=3, ell>=1 the exact geodesic face classification expresses the complex as a join of r discrete arm sets plus central and intra-arm one-cells. Simply connectedness of the join permits an integral, S_r-equivariant chain projection: H1 is the oriented internal depth-edge module plus the central-edge coefficient-sum-zero module. The top join homology is the sign-twisted tensor product of arm augmentation lattices; switching join factors contributes the sign. Transfer after equivariant barycentric subdivision computes rational quotient homology as invariants, giving exact ranks C(ell,2)+ell-1 and C(ell-1,r). Finite complete-graph-distance and signed chain-Lefschetz checks passed for 9 parameter profiles, 981 faces and 336 group elements. Checks support rather than replace the infinite proof; quotient integral torsion is not claimed.

value.rationale: The complete integral arm-permutation representation on both nonzero homology degrees and the exact geometric quotient rational homology detect natural symmetry information invisible to the known spider counting polynomial. A sharp top-class survival threshold ell=r+1 separates exponentially many nonsymmetric sphere classes from the alternating invariants of the quotient; the H1 module also identifies geometric loop origins. This is a natural infinite family, not an arbitrary finite slice, and does not depend on unproved general downstream applications.
